body: Spec for the 2026-09-28 live-check findings approved and dispatched.U+000AU+000AU+002D Spec: docs/specs/live-check-findings.md (decisions, items, repro alongside; git-ignored). Four Steps, each its own draft PR on feat/composer-editor-core from aa5bf95: ime-commit-on-blur, shell-focus-groups, focus-ring-outset, android-focus-highlight.U+000AU+002D Two spec reviews changed the design:U+000A  U+002D The outside ring is clipped in the 48 px format bar, in scrolled lists and on search cards. The owner chose "outside, with exceptions": the ring reveals itself; the format bar and the draft chip's Discard keep the edge ring; the search list gets 6 px of room.U+000A  U+002D Shell Tab and Shift+Tab laps needed a focus-in-view listener in each shell, because route wrap-around bypasses per-group policies. Settings is now built as a column, because Shift+Tab cannot reach lazily built rows.U+000AU+002D Verified in a probe worktree:U+000A  U+002D each Step alone passes the full suite (3,410 to 3,416 tests) with clean analysis;U+000A  U+002D every acceptance test fails without its Step;U+000A  U+002D all four together pass 3,425 tests, and flutter build apk --debug succeeds.U+000A  U+002D test/tooling/android_dump_rules_test.dart is flaky under full-suite load.U+000AU+002D mitosis run: run dir .fanout/live-check-findings, run kit ~/.mitosis/field-notes/live-check-findings (charter, wrappers, pr_adapter.py, run.items.json, run.log).U+000AU+002D After merge: live checks 10.9 (Mac sandbox, Japanese app switch) and 10.10 (Galaxy Note 10+, Tab and Shift+Tab laps, ring, no lime outline).
